title: Placing a quiz answer by hash instead of by choice

concepts.description: Deriving a choice from a hash of the input so it is uniformly spread and reproducible, rather than random or left to judgement.
concepts.context: answerPosition hashes the question text so the same question always lands in the same slot and the slots stay even

concepts.description: When the correct answer sits in the same place too often, respondents learn the position instead of the material and the instrument stops measuring.
concepts.context: the slot is assigned server-side precisely because a generator left to itself puts the answer first nearly every time
